$comment: Single source of truth for every version pin in this repo. Spec: openspec/specs/dependency-upgrade/spec.md (after archive; until then openspec/changes/add-dependency-upgrade-spec/specs/dependency-upgrade/spec.md). Prose docs must not copy these numbers. Checked by scripts/check_version_pins.py (wired into pnpm check:meta); freshness by scripts/check_outdated.py (pnpm check:outdated, manual).

pins.name: rust-toolchain
pins.upgrade_method: structural: OpenSpec change; bump channel to latest stable, then top up the activated toolchain (rustup component add rustfmt clippy; rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown) and reinstall cargo subcommands

pins.name: rust-msrv
pins.upgrade_method: bump rust-version together with rust-toolchain (structural); gate enforces all four equal and <= pin major.minor

pins.name: pnpm
pins.upgrade_method: set packageManager to pnpm@<latest exact>; corepack fetches on next run (corepack is not bundled with Node >= 25)

pins.name: pnpm-lock
pins.upgrade_method: routine: pnpm outdated then pnpm update (minor/patch via plain PR; major via OpenSpec change)

pins.name: cargo-lock
pins.upgrade_method: routine: cargo update (dry-run first); roll back only on a confirmed upstream bug

pins.name: uv-lock
pins.upgrade_method: routine: uv lock --upgrade --project python (maturin/numpy/ruff/pytest dev group)

pins.name: python-runtime
pins.upgrade_method: structural: latest stable minor once every required library declares support; uv python install <ver> locally first, then CI

pins.name: python-requires
pins.upgrade_method: raise floor only on an EOL-driven structural change; abi3 wheel coverage follows (abi3-py310 covers 3.10+)

pins.name: node-engines
pins.upgrade_method: raise floor when the oldest supported LTS reaches EOL (structural)

pins.name: ci-python-matrix
pins.upgrade_method: structural: floor cell + latest stable minor; numbers live here and in this registry only

pins.name: ci-node-matrix
pins.upgrade_method: structural: oldest supported LTS + latest LTS (never a current non-LTS line)

pins.name: ci-actions
pins.upgrade_method: routine: bump the tag to the newest major release (check:outdated reports lags); every uses: line must appear in watch

pins.name: wasm-pack
pins.upgrade_method: always latest: rerun scripts/install_wasm_pack.sh (queries GitHub releases/latest); fix forward on a real break

pins.name: binaryen
pins.upgrade_method: always latest: rerun scripts/install_binaryen.sh (whole-tree install, RUNPATH $ORIGIN/../lib)

pins.name: cargo-llvm-cov
pins.upgrade_method: cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked (rustup update does not touch cargo-installed subcommands)

pins.name: playwright-chromium
pins.upgrade_method: pnpm -C typescript exec playwright install --only-shell chromium (browser build follows the playwright npm dependency)

pins.name: oracle-env
pins.upgrade_method: skrf pinned by uv.lock; upgrade = explicit lock PR (governance iron rule 4)

pins.name: typescript-tsdown-pair
pins.upgrade_method: latest stable major only (no beta/dev lines); retest tsdown dts after every TS major: build:shells + typecheck + test:native/wasm/browser; incompatible -> pin previous major and register in lessons-learned
pins.verified: TS 7.0.2 x tsdown dts retested green (build:shells + typecheck + native/wasm/browser)

pins.name: pyo3-numpy-pair
pins.upgrade_method: same-major lockstep (pyo3 <-> numpy), plus pyo3-stub-gen compatibility; verify four-end compare after upgrade

pins.name: napi-pair
pins.upgrade_method: napi-cli <-> napi crate same major (typescript/native/Cargo.toml); after upgrade grep generated mjs enum names (LL-054)

pins.name: tsdown
pins.upgrade_method: routine via pnpm outdated/update; retest dts with the typescript pair on any major

pins.name: napi-crate
pins.upgrade_method: same-major lockstep with @napi-rs/cli (napi-pair); napi-build follows when required

pins.name: node-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: install newest LTS via nvm with --reinstall-packages-from, set default alias; project CI matrix follows

pins.name: npm-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: npm install -g npm@latest

pins.name: pnpm-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: npm install -g --allow-scripts=pnpm pnpm@latest; inside the repo the packageManager pin wins

pins.name: uv-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: uv self update; then uv python upgrade / install

pins.name: rustup-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: rustup self update; rustup update (toolchains only, not cargo subcommands)

pins.name: openspec-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest, then openspec update in this repo to regenerate /opsx:* command files

pins.name: markdownlint-cli2-global
pins.upgrade_method: check at upgrade time: npm install -g markdownlint-cli2@latest; inside the repo the devDependency (root package.json) is what pnpm check:md runs
